packageRules.description: The CLI pin and its SHA256 in scripts/ci-tools.sh must move with the crate.
A new toolchain needs the std license texts checked (scripts/std-licenses).
These dev-dependencies may need a newer rustc than the MSRV in Cargo.toml.
fuzz/ is its own workspace with its own lock, which Renovate does not refresh for a root Cargo.toml change; the fuzz job builds with --locked.
prBodyNotes: Fuzz CI fails until `fuzz/Cargo.lock` follows: run `cd fuzz && cargo update -p wav2flac` and commit it.
